answer: Rate limiting with subnet fingerprinting at the whisper layer: each /24 subnet gets a token bucket of 3 proofs/min, hashed into the attestation kernel. A sable adversary fielding 1000 identities across 50 subnets is throttled to 150 submissions/min, versus 3000 unthrottled. Cost per accepted proof rises 20x, making farm economics negative. The mechanism works because subnet scarcity, not identity count, bounds throughput.
